When an agent is about to do something dangerous — delete a database, force push, expose a key publicly — the bot sends a card: what the agent wants, why it's dangerous and how to do it safer.

Decide with one button: Allow, Deny, My instruction, I'll handle it or Always allow. No answer means the action is blocked.
en.TwoKey — второй ключ для ИИ-агентов. Опа:
TwoKey is a second key for AI agents. The agent's dangerous actions arrive here as a card with buttons:
✅ Allow — run it once
❌ Deny — the agent gets a refusal and suggests a safe path
✍️ My instruction — reply with text, and the agent will do it your way
🛠 I'll handle it — the agent stops and waits
♾ Always allow — for the “high” level: TwoKey won't ask again about the same action in the same folder

Commands:
/status — protection status
/templates — ready-made templates
/lang — language
/panel — TwoKey window
/always — what's always allowed
/forget <id> — undo “always”

✅ Өткізу — бір рет орындау
